keys_hint: {#kbd}{letters}{/kbd} or {#kbd}{digits}{/kbd} pick an answer, {#kbd}Enter{/kbd} moves on
finish_waiting: Your work is saved. The grade will appear once the connection is back
toast_offline: No connection. Your answers are saved

match.countPlural=one: {count} answer is kept on this computer and will be sent once the connection is back
match.countPlural=*: {count} answers are kept on this computer and will be sent once the connection is back

toast_offline_none: New answers will be kept on this computer too
error_offline: Can’t reach the teacher’s computer. Try again.
error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
join_hint: Enter the four digits your teacher shows on the board
join_bad_code: No test has this code. Check the digits on the board.
pick_name_taken: This name is already in use on computer {label}. Call your teacher.
save_failed: Answers can’t be saved on this computer, but they are being sent
kicked_title: Your teacher sent you back to choose your name
kicked_text: Choose your name again to carry on.
moved_title: The test continues on another computer
moved_text: Your answers are saved. You can close this tab.
other_tab_title: The test is already open in another tab
other_tab_text: Carry on there and close this tab.
address_hint: Your teacher shows the new address on the board, for example 10.0.0.5:8080.
address_bad: That doesn’t look like an address. Copy it from the board, for example 10.0.0.5:8080.
pick_taken_plain: This name is already in use. Call your teacher.
error_unreachable: Couldn’t connect to the teacher’s computer
test_too_new: This test was made by a newer version of Klats. Update the program.
auth_open_from_app: Open Klats from the desktop app.
banner_port_busy: Port {port} is used by another program. Students cannot connect.
network_none: This computer is not on a network, so students cannot connect.
tests_delete_failed: Could not delete the test. Try again.
tests_empty_text: Create your first test: add questions, mark the right answers and start it for a class.
classes_empty_text: Create a class and type in the students’ names, or paste a list from Excel or the class register.
classes_paste: Paste the list from Excel or the class register
classes_paste_hint: Select the surname and first-name columns in your spreadsheet, copy them and paste them on the left. Row numbers and headers are dropped.
classes_name_required: Give the class a name of up to 60 characters.
classes_name_too_long: This name is too long: “{name}”. Keep only the surname and first name on the line.
settings_address_hint: Students open it in a browser and enter the test code.
settings_network_hint: This computer is on several networks. Choose the one the students’ computers are on.
settings_port_hint: The part of the address after the colon. Change it only if another program uses the port.
settings_port_invalid: A port is a number from 1 to 65535.
settings_restart: Changes take effect after Klats restarts
classes_paste_failed: Could not read the list. Try again.
builder_question_placeholder: For example: How many bits are in a byte?
builder_partial_hint: The points are split between the correct answers. Each wrong tick takes a share away.
builder_all_hint: Points only when every correct answer is ticked and no wrong one.
builder_empty_text: Press “Add question”, or paste ready questions from Word or another document.
checks_ok: Every question has text and correct answers.
problem_no_correct: Question {number}: mark at least one correct answer.
problem_too_few_options: Question {number}: add at least two answers.
problem_single_many_correct: Question {number} takes one answer, but {count} are marked correct. A student can pick only one, so no one can score on it.
problem_weak_partial: Question {number}: with partial credit, ticking everything still scores. Add wrong answers or choose “All or nothing”.
types_text: You can change the type later; the answers stay.
type_multi_desc: The student ticks every correct answer
paste_text: Copy questions from Word or another document. Number each question and letter its answers a), b), c). Mark the correct ones with an asterisk *.
paste_placeholder:
1. How many bits are in a byte?
a) 4
*b) 8
c) 16
paste_none: No questions found. Check the numbers and the answer letters.
start_text: Which class? Students will find themselves on its list.
start_no_list_desc: Students type their surname, first name and class
start_active: Another test is running. End it to start this one.
start_save_failed: Could not save the test. Try again.
live_kick_text: The computer goes back to choosing a name, and the test starts over. Answers already given won’t count.
live_rename_text: Only you see this name, in the “PC” column.
live_no_events: Events show up here: who joined, who went offline, who finished.
ev_clash: The name “{name}” is in use on computer {holder}. It was just chosen on computer {newcomer} too.
ev_clash_done: The name “{name}” was chosen on two computers: {holder} and {newcomer}.
ev_offline: {name} is offline. The answers are kept on that computer.
ev_online_synced: {name} is back online. Answers saved during the outage that arrived: {count}.
ev_switch_again: {name} switches to another window again, time {count}.
ev_late: {name} sends answers after the test ended: {count}.
board_scan: Or scan it with a tablet
board_qr: QR code of the test address

match.countPlural=one: {count} student is still writing. Their answers so far will be saved and graded.
match.countPlural=*: {count} students are still writing. Their answers so far will be saved and graded.

live_none_text: Open a test in “My tests” and press “Start the test”.
results_empty_text: Start a test for a class, and every student’s grade will show up here.
results_write_failed: The file could not be written. If it is open in Excel, close it and try again.
